channel.title: Family Packages on YumFam
channel.description: Recent content in Family Packages on YumFam

item.title: Guizhou Astronomy & Caving Family Tour from ¥3,380 (≈$470): 5 Days / 4 Nights, FAST Telescope, Miao Village & Cave Rope Adventure
item.description:
Deal price: 5-day / 4-night tour, child — from ¥3,380 (≈$470; adult from ¥3,980) · Departures Nov 11–21, 2026 and Jan 23 – Feb 11, 2027 · One family minimum to run

This is a proper expedition, not a sightseeing bus: five days across Guizhou built around the FAST radio telescope — the world’s largest single-dish telescope — plus a real caving descent on ropes, a Miao village visit and hands-on geology, led by an astronomy professor, cave coaches and a geology guide. Days run from Guiyang to Pingtang (FAST) and Kaili (caves and Miao culture), with a professional family-tour leader and a photographer along.

item.title: Yichun Snow RV Family Tour from ¥4,980 (≈$692): 6 Days / 5 Nights, Ski Lessons, Ice Fishing & Reindeer Tribe
item.description:
Deal price: 6-day / 5-night snow RV tour, child — from ¥4,980 (≈$692; adult from ¥5,980, early-bird ¥1,000 off) · Departures Jan 19 – Feb 21, 2027 · One family per RV

This is winter in Heilongjiang done properly: six days from Harbin into the snow country around Yichun, travelling in a heated snow-themed RV — one family to a vehicle — through the Lesser Khingan forest. The trip packs in a 1-on-1 ski lesson, ice fishing and a winter-catch demonstration, reindeer interaction and feeding, an Oroqen tribe visit, a snowfield hotpot glamping lunch, and 10+ snow activities, with a guide, a safety host and a photographer along the way. Nights are in 5-diamond Harbin hotels and Yichun resorts, not in the RV.

item.title: Harbin & Yichun Winter Family Tour from ¥3,980 (≈$553): 6 Days / 5 Nights, 2 Nights in Harbin, Ski Lessons, Ice Fishing & Jade Hot Spring
item.description:
Deal price: 6 days / 5 nights from ¥3,980 per child (≈$553, was ¥4,980, early-bird ¥1,000 off) · Adults from ¥4,980 (≈$692) · Departures Jan 19 – Feb 21, 2027 · Confirm with customer service after booking

This is the closest bookable way into Harbin’s ice season on the platform right now: the tour spends 2 nights in Harbin (Steigenberger, or Crowne Plaza as the alternative), then heads 4 hours east into the snow forests of Yichun in the Lesser Khingan Mountains. One thing to know upfront: the Harbin Ice and Snow World visit is on your own time during the Harbin free time — its ticket is not included in the tour price. What is included is the Northeast Tiger Park, the ski lessons, the ice carnival and the hot spring below. The Harbin nights give you the time to visit the Ice and Snow World, St Sophia Cathedral and Central Street yourself — the hotel is about 15 minutes from the Ice and Snow World.

item.title: Inner Mongolia Keshiketeng Snow Family Tour from ¥3,080 (≈$428): 6 Days / 5 Nights, Chongli Ski Lessons, Winter Fishing & Reindeer Tribe
item.description:
Deal price: 6 days / 5 nights from ¥3,080 per child (≈$428, was ¥3,980, early-bird ¥900 off) · Adults from ¥3,680 (≈$511) · Departures Dec 19, 2026 – Jan 20, 2027 · Confirm with customer service after booking

This is not a hotel deal — it is a 6-day guided snow journey into Inner Mongolia, built around one idea: the “fire” of the northern winter. The route runs from Beijing to the Chongli ski resort (a 2022 Winter Olympics venue), then deep into the snowfields of Ulan Butong and Keshiketeng. It is the only December-departure northern snow tour on the booking platform right now, and the pace is deliberately slow — fewer stops, more time in each place — which matters at minus twenty degrees with kids in tow.

item.title: Suzhou Jingzhi Farm Harvest Half-Day Camp ¥98 (≈$14) for 1 Adult + 1 Child: Rice Cutting, Scarecrows & Farm Games
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child (under 12) half-day camp — ¥98 (≈$14, was ¥128) · Valid October 24 – December 13, 2026 · 09:00–16:00

Autumn turns the rice paddies gold at Jingzhi Farm （鲸治·部落生态循环农场）, an eco-farm in Linhu, Wuzhong — and this half-day camp drops the family right into the harvest. The morning runs on farm work and farm games: a grain talk and farm-tool intro, rice cutting and threshing, scarecrow making, tug-of-war, egg tapping, a paper-plane contest, goose ring toss and pet feeding. Between games there is a rice-paddy oil-painting photo stop, a paddy maze treasure hunt and the farm’s net-famous rice-paddy swing, and every adult gets a free Americano. The egg-tapping game has a real stake: beat the other families and the day’s “egg champion” takes home a free-range chicken if 30+ families are playing (or 10 eggs if fewer); the paper-plane winner takes home stream-tracing tickets for next year.

item.title: Guangzhou Cave Adventure Park from ¥228 (≈$32): 1 Adult + 1 Child, 2.5 Hours Across 10 Cave Routes
item.description:
Deal price: 1 adult + 1 child, 2.5-hour caving ticket — ¥228 (≈$32, was ¥318) · 10 cave routes across 5 themed zones · Helmets, knee and elbow pads provided · Valid August 23 – December 31, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unused · Buy by 23:59 the day before for the ¥228 advance price

Guangzhou’s “Elf Forest”-themed indoor caving park — over a kilometre of cave passages plus a giant maze cave — inside the Six Elements complex in Pazhou. One ticket covers 2.5 hours of caving plus a castle quest game across five zones: the Experience Zone (15 minutes, climb through the elf tree trunk, cross the high rope net and push through an ice world of snow blocks and stalactite columns), the Maze Zone (25–35 minutes, a karst labyrinth of stalactites, rubble and rope nets — watch out for the skeleton pit), the Science Zone (15–25 minutes, a Jurassic fossil world where kids dig for dinosaur, fish and trilobite fossils and hunt for a hidden treasure chest), the Magic Zone (20–25 minutes, a kaleidoscope ocean-ball mirror house and double-decker secret rooms) and the Challenge Zone (three routes: the 77-metre Ghost Cave Trail, the high-difficulty Extreme Challenge with slanted boards and yoga-ball chambers, and the Wind Cave where you push against winds from level 3 to level 7). A competition zone opens when matches are running.

item.title: Jiaxing Senbo Water Park Tickets from ¥99 (≈$14): Indoor Heated Water Park + Fantasy Island, Valid to June 2027
item.description:
Deal price: Water park single ticket — ¥99 (≈$14, was ¥288) · 5,600㎡ indoor heated water park, 30+ attractions · Valid October 23, 2026 – June 30, 2027 · ⏰ refundable anytime if unused · Book by 23:58 the day before

⚠️ Important seasonal note: the indoor water park is closed for maintenance from November 2, 2026 to April 2, 2027, and tickets are replaced by Xihe Hot Spring during that period (open November 5, 2026 – March 28, 2027). Neither venue is open November 2–4, 2026 or March 29 – April 2, 2027, so plan around those dates. Fantasy Island stays open year-round. If you are buying right now, you are buying a hot-spring ticket that converts back to the water park when it reopens in April 2027.

item.title: Yixing Yao Lake Town Stay from ¥599 (≈$83): Pottery Town + Hillside Train + Bird Show in Jiangsu
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night, Taolu boutique guesthouse (king or balcony twin, 30–40㎡) — ¥599 (≈$83, was ¥799) · Breakfast for 2 · Unlimited Yao Lake Town entry during your stay · “Flying Bird” show tickets for 2 + souvenir gift + dining discount perks · Valid October 20 – December 30, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved · Book by 17:00 the day before

A stay inside a pottery town: Yao Lake Town (窑湖小镇) is a lakeside old-street-and-kiln resort in Yixing, the Jiangsu city famous for purple-clay (zisha) teapots. The town is built around that heritage — a recreated dragon kiln, old-street lanes, a bird show in a valley theatre, and the “Cloud Train,” a hillside mini-train looping through bamboo, tea fields and the lake (guests call the night run, with its water-screen, lights and fireworks, the signature experience). The town is open 09:00–22:00 with last entry at 21:00, and staying guests can come and go freely during their stay, with shuttle buses inside the resort.

item.title: Shenzhen Hurricane Adventure — Full-Sensory Immersive Park from ¥29.9 (≈$4)
item.description:
Deal price: single ticket — ¥29.9 (≈$4) (was ¥88) · Parent-child ticket (1 adult + 1 child under 1.5 m) — ¥39.9 (≈$6, was ¥128) · Family ticket (2 adults + 1 child, or 1 adult + 2 children under 1.5 m) — ¥49.9 (≈$7, was ¥168) · Bookable Oct 27 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

In Shenzhen’s Nanshan district, Hurricane Adventure is a full-sensory immersive park built around two original shows that loop all day: The North Sea Kraken and Ne Zha Stirs the Sea. A giant immersive screen, multi-sensory effects and motion-adventure staging put you inside the story rather than in front of it — and one ticket covers both shows with unlimited same-day re-entry, so you can step out for a meal and come back for another round.

item.title: Hefei Yuanxiao'ao Magic Bookstore — 1,500㎡ Immersive Kids' Wonderland from ¥79 (≈$11)
item.description:
Deal price: parent-child ticket (1 adult + 1 child under 1.5 m) — ¥79 (≈$11) (was ¥199) · 2-person ticket — ¥89 (≈$13, was ¥258) · Family ticket — ¥118 (≈$17, was ¥299) · Bookable Oct 26 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Tucked into Hefei’s Hechai 1972 cultural park, Yuanxiao’ao is a 1,500㎡ “magic bookstore” where bookshelves give way to immersive worlds. One ticket covers the lot: Deep-Sea Fantasy, Dinosaur Archives and Space Voyage zones, Fly over China and Fly over Anhui in the motion flying cinema, a 9 m six-screen sci-fi CAVE space with 100-megapixel 720° immersion, and the Magic Creative Space — magic painting, building blocks and star sand for younger makers. The wristband allows unlimited same-day re-entry, so you can dip in and out between the park’s cafés and shops.

item.title: Chikan Ancient Town Resort, Kaiping — 1 Night + 2 Days Unlimited Park Entry for 2 Adults & 2 Kids, from ¥728 (≈$103)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 2 days unlimited park entry for 2 adults & 2 kids — from ¥728 (≈$103) (was ¥1,588, about 46% of list) · Bookable through Dec 30, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 30, 2026

Chikan is one of Guangdong’s most lovingly kept old towns: arcaded qilou streets built by returned overseas Chinese, a hundred shows a month, and a new theme every season — right now it’s the Chikan Monster Night (Oct 15 – Nov 6), with parades down streets paved orange with marigolds. This Double-11 bundle puts you inside it: 1 night in an official town hotel, 2 days of unlimited re-entry to the whole ancient town for 2 adults and 2 kids (kids under 1.2 m), breakfasts, a free in-town shuttle, and two “Grandmaster” theatre seats (limited, first-come-first-served).

item.title: Qingdao Sunac Land — 10 Rides Unlimited for 2 Days, from ¥99 (≈$14)
item.description:
Deal price: 10 rides, unlimited, for 2 consecutive days — from ¥99 (≈$14) (was ¥138, about 72% of list) · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

Qingdao’s one-stop indoor family park inside the Oriental Movie Metropolis (Sunac Mall), split into two themed zones — Laoshan Wonders and a German-style town. The headline rides: Laoshan Flying Dragon, a custom indoor suspended coaster that dives from a mountaintop into the sea; a 16.6 m pendulum swinging a full 240°; a rocket-style drop tower; a spinning music ship; plus gentler classics — carousel, flower-basket Ferris wheel, samba balloons, bumper cars and an 80 m indoor driving school for little drivers. One ticket covers all 10 rides, unlimited, across 2 consecutive days — go back the next day and ride your favorites again.

item.title: Qiyun Mountain Ziyoujia Treehouse World — Sleep in a Treehouse + Full Scenic Ticket Pack, from ¥699 (≈$98)
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night in a treehouse + breakfasts + full scenic ticket pack — from ¥699 (≈$98) (was ¥2,599, about 27% of list) · Bookable through Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ valid through Dec 31, 2026

“Go to the mountains — nature has the answers” is this place’s motto, and it delivers: 21 themed treehouses and villas — Lego-block, North American, steam-train, lighthouse, watchtower, flying-saucer and even a 123㎡ “airplane” masterwork — scattered through the pine forests of Qiyun Mountain, one of China’s four great Taoist mountains. Each sits apart with its own patch of mountain and cloud, many with viewing decks where you can watch the morning mist from bed. Around 3 hours by car from Shanghai, 2 hours from Hangzhou, with a shuttle from Huangshan North station.

item.title: Qingdao Sports Town Fun World — Unlimited Rides All Day, ¥49 (≈$7)
item.description:
Deal price: unlimited same-day rides — from ¥49 (≈$7) (was ¥199, about 25% of list) · No ticket exchange needed, buy and go · ⏰ valid through Dec 13, 2026

One of the best-value family days out in Qingdao right now. Sports Town Fun World sits inside the 200-mu Citizen Fitness Center on the city’s north coast (Metro Line 8, Citizen Fitness Center station; near the international expo center and the outlet mall), and a single ticket unlocks 10 attractions unlimited all day: space walk, peace mission, rainbow slide, lakeside train, bumper cars, dream carousel, bay racing, dynamic flying chairs, high-altitude rafting and a water yacht — plus 3 themed parks (dinosaur park, cute-pet park and a non-powered play park) and the brand-new QIQI indoor trampoline zone. Lifelike dinosaurs — T. rex, the meat-eating giant Niu Long — walk you straight into a Jurassic jungle, and the bouncy-cloud zone suits kids of all ages. You can even bring your own tent and camp on the lawn for an outdoor day.

item.title: Moganshan Senbo Resort: Mountain Family Stay from ¥759 (≈$105) — Oct–Mar No Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: ¥759 (≈$105, was ¥1598 — 53% off) for 1 night · ⏰ Valid October 22, 2026 – June 30, 2027 · Oct–Mar no surcharge (except New Year & Spring Festival) · Refundable if unbooked

A mountain-air family resort an hour from Hangzhou: the ¥759 tier buys a Senbo garden-view twin room for 1 night with breakfast for 2, 2 tickets to either the water park or Fantasy Island, a family photo shoot (3 retouched photos + a 15-second video), welcome fruit, Flora Garden entry and the resort’s kids’ play areas (including the “Yo Yo Tribe” zone and a horse-riding taster). The whole October-to-March stretch carries no surcharge — except New Year and Spring Festival — so this is a genuine winter-mountain deal, not a shoulder-season teaser.

item.title: Rizhao Senbo Resort: Seaside Family Stay from ¥599 (≈$83) — Weekends & New Year No Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: ¥599 (≈$83, was ¥1099 — 45% off) for 1 night · ⏰ Valid October 22, 2026 – April 5, 2027 · Weekends & New Year at no surcharge · Refundable if unbooked

A Yellow Sea beach break with the kids’ parks built in: the ¥599 tier buys a deluxe room or a Senbo cabin room for 1 night with breakfast for 2, 2 tickets to either the water park or Fantasy Island (pick at check-in, unlimited re-entry until noon the next day), a family photo shoot (3 retouched photos + a 15-second video), welcome fruit and a first-night minibar round. The resort sits inside the Wanpingkou Seaside Scenic Area, so the beach is a walk away, and weekends and New Year carry no surcharge.

item.title: Shanghai ICE FAMILY Ice Park ¥61 (≈$8.50) for 2 Sessions: 90-Minute Skates at LaLaport Jinqiao
item.description:
Deal price: ¥61 (≈$8.50, was ¥200) · ⏰ Valid May 27 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⛸️ 2 × 90-minute sessions · Skates, helmet & protective gear included · Refundable anytime

At roughly ¥30 per session — about 30% of the walk-in price — this is Shanghai’s cheapest ticket onto real ice. ICE FAMILY’s rink at LaLaport Jinqiao (Pudong) is the trendy, beginner-friendly one: a fashion-forward space with a huge real-ice floor, 90 minutes of skating per visit, and full kit provided — skates, helmet and protective gear for head, knees, elbows and feet. Staff help you gear up before you step on and walk you through the on-ice basics.

item.title: Xiamen Champions Ice Rink ¥148 (≈$21) for 2: 2 Hours on Xiamen's 1,600㎡ Olympic Real-Ice Sheet
item.description:
Deal price: ¥148 (≈$21, was ¥200) · ⏰ Valid Jul 2 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⛸️ 2 hours for 2 skaters · Skates, helmet, socks & insurance included · Refundable anytime

Forget the synthetic panels — this is real ice, 1,600 square meters of it, an Olympic-standard sheet held at a constant -10°C year-round. Champions Ice Rink (冠军冰场) in Xiamen’s Zhonghua City has been the city’s serious skating venue since 2015, with a full ice-making system, professional lighting and sound, and a coaching team of competition-level athletes. One ticket covers two skaters for a full 2 hours — take the kids, take a date, or split it with a friend.

item.title: Bounce Beast Sports Park Halloween Month from ¥198 (≈$28): Parent-Child Sessions in Shanghai, Hangzhou & Chengdu
item.description:
Deal price: parent-child session (1 adult + 1 child) — from ¥198 (≈$28, was ¥296, about 67% of list) · Usable Oct 31 – Nov 29, 2026 only — tickets cannot be used before Oct 31 · ⏰ buy by 23:59 the day before; unused vouchers refundable anytime

Bounce Beast Super Sports Center （弹力猩球·超级运动中心） turns its indoor sports arenas over to a month-long Halloween party — the “Beast Halloween Carnival Month” （怪开猩狂欢月）, a parent-child festival opening on Halloween day itself, Oct 31, running through Nov 29. The seasonal programme layers a trick-or-treat parade, pumpkin battles, a zombie maze, broomstick flying races, a scarecrow relay and eyeball bowling over the usual trampolines, climbing and aerial courses, with a cauldron-fishing side quest and Beast Coins to win and swap for limited surprise gifts. Three cities take part: Shanghai (three stores — Qibao Link, Sun Palace and Nanxiang Impression City MEGA), Hangzhou (Joy City) and Chengdu (Zhaoshang Damofang).

item.title: Qiandaohu Powei Yiqu Resort from ¥299 (≈$42)/Night with 3 Daily Meals — Autumn 4-Night Bundle ¥699
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥299/night (≈$42, was ¥899) · ⏰ Valid through Jan 1, 2027 · ⏰ No surcharge on weekends or New Year’s Day · ⏰ Limited free upgrade to family/parent-child rooms

The Powei Yiqu Resort is French group Pierre & Vacances’ （太阳季） brand-new resort in Qiandaohu’s Alpha City — a futuristic island-style complex of four modern buildings on the Pearl Peninsula, where most rooms come with private balconies facing the lake. Dining covers several restaurants serving local Qiandaohu cuisine, and the resort packs in a 1,000㎡+ kids’ park, gym, chess rooms, table tennis and billiards, plus craft workshops like glass lampwork and pottery (some paid). The headline bundle: 4 nights with 3 meals a day for ¥699 — a stay where you never have to think about where to eat.

item.title: Shanghai Teddy Bear Jungle Park — ¥69 (≈$10): 9 Play Zones, Kids' Theater, LEGO Tables & DIY Crafts
item.description:
Deal price: ¥69 (≈$10, was ¥109) for 1 adult + 1 child · 2 adults + 1 child ¥89 (was ¥129) · ⏰ Valid through Nov 30, 2026 · Refundable if unreserved

The Korean teddy-bear phenomenon lands in Pudong: TEDDY ISLAND’s Teddy Bear Jungle Park (L3, Meida Commercial Plaza, Lane 3-8, No. 5 Mingfei Road, Zhuqiao Town) builds an indoor playground around the Jeju Teddy Bear Museum’s beloved IP — plush bears in costume tucked through painted jungle scenery, equal parts playdate and photo shoot. The 9 play zones, all included in the ticket, are: a kids’ theater with interactive games, a snake slide, interactive projection games, a craft workshop zone (DIY makes to take home), an ocean-ball pit, a sand-play area, a baking zone, a reading house, and spinning chairs. It’s a contained, soft, photo-friendly half-day for the under-school-age crowd — the Zhuqiao location also puts it on the Pudong airport side of the city, an easy add-on around a Disney or flight day.

item.title: Suzhou Gulliver Parent-Child Resort Hotel from ¥399 (≈$56): Themed Room + Breakfast + Petting Zoo & Indoor Kids' Park
item.description:
Deal price: ¥399 (≈$56, was ¥499) · ⏰ Valid Oct 23, 2026 – Feb 28, 2027 · ⏰ No surcharge on weekends or New Year’s Day · Refundable if unreserved

Inside the Jiangnan Botanical Garden on the shores of Taihu Lake (Wuzhong District, Suzhou — under an hour from the city centre), the Suzhou Gulliver Parent-Child Resort Hotel turns Gulliver’s Travels into a place to sleep. Instead of merely tolerating children, the resort is built from a child’s eye level: a “Lilliput” of oversized furniture seen as the tiny residents would see it, proportion-play surprises hidden in the corridors, and garden landscaping that shrinks adults to finger size. Some rooms even have star-gazing skylights. Every tier includes breakfast for two, 2 tickets to the DuoDuo petting zoo (alpacas, cats, peacocks — close enough to stroke, feed and photograph), the indoor kids’ park, and free roaming of the botanical garden itself, with its themed planting zones and small zoo.

item.title: Quanzhou Oulebao Fairyland ¥769 (≈$108): 1 Night Hotel + 2A2C Breakfast + Theme-Park Tickets
item.description:
Deal price: ¥769 (≈$108, was ¥1888, about 59% off) · ⏰ Valid Oct 16–Nov 30, 2026 · ⏰ No surcharge for off-peak weekends · ⏰ Refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

On the Hui’an coast in Quanzhou’s Taiwan Investment Zone, the Bashian Guohai (“Eight Immortals Crossing the Sea”) Resort pairs a night at one of two themed hotels with its Fairy Tale World theme park. You choose at booking: a Eurasia room at the Water Park Hotel (163 themed rooms, 35–70㎡, in a castle-style building between hill and sea; mountain or garden view, assigned) or a Navigator twin / Voyager family / Dreamer family room at the Zheng He Treasure Ship Hotel (200+ nautical-themed rooms, 50㎡ and up, all with balconies and a full set of kids’ amenities down to step stools and child toiletries). Either way the bundle adds buffet breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids (under 1.2m), Fairy Tale World admission for 2A2C with unlimited re-entry throughout the stay, welcome fruit on arrival, free parking, and evening access to the Treasure Ship’s private beach and the Ocean Hotel’s private pool.

item.title: Shanghai Brightland Kids' Play Park from ¥59 (≈$8): Dual-Park Card with Four Seasons Ice & Snow World
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥59 (≈$8) · ⏰ Valid Oct 9–Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ Usable on weekends and public holidays, no reservation or ticket exchange needed · ⏰ Refundable anytime

Brightland （耀心岛） is Shanghai’s immersive indoor kids’ play-park brand — not the usual ball-pit template, but miniature real-world cities where children check in for a “flight” (real security screening, boarding and meal service), bake with real ovens, run a supermarket checkout, staff a police station, hospital and fire crew. The LCM Pudong store (3F, LCM Place mall) packs 3,000+㎡, 100+ activities and a 200,000-ball ocean pit; the Qingpu store (Yuanzu Dream World, Zhao Xiang) is a ~5,000㎡ fairy-tale castle inside a “tree hole,” with 24 themed scenes over three floors. This offer pairs it with the Four Seasons Ice & Snow World in the same Qingpu mall — real snow, slides and snow tubes — so one card covers both parks in one trip. Suggested play time is 4–6 hours per park.

item.title: Shanghai Yaoxue Snow World + Ice-Snow Hotel from ¥799 (≈$112): 2-Day Snow-Play Passes + Hot Spring + 1 Night — Ski Bundles from ¥999
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥799 (≈$112, was ¥1,598, about 50% off) · Valid through Dec 30, 2026 · ⏰ refundable if unreserved, auto-refund on expiry

Shanghai’s Yaoxue Ice & Snow World — a ~350,000㎡ indoor winter resort with a 98,000㎡+ real-snow hall kept at −3 °C to −5 °C — is the rare ski trip that needs no mountain. The hotel half of the deal is the Lingang Ice-Snow Mingcheng Hotel, the snow world’s own south-district partner hotel — a twin-peaks building styled like an ice kingdom, a short walk from the slopes, with ice-and-snow themed superior rooms (dry/wet separated bathrooms, picture windows, a kids’ playroom downstairs).

item.title: Disney 100 Years of Wonder Exhibition — China Premiere in Beijing (from ¥108)
item.description:
Deal price: from ¥108 (≈$15) (was ¥188 — up to 43% off) · ¥3 off orders ¥100+ · Xialv Money-Saver Card: ¥30 off this product + ¥50 welcome bonus on signup

The China premiere of Disney 100 Years of Wonder is now open at Beijing Chaoyang Joy City (10F, 101 Chaoyang North Road): a walk-through century of Disney drawn from the Walt Disney Archives — the studio’s own vault of original props, costumes and artwork, most of it never previously shown in China. The route moves decade by decade through the stories: early animation treasures, Cinderella’s glass slipper, Marvel artifacts, a full-size BB-8 from the Star Wars sequels, and immersive music-and-story galleries that build to a cinema-style finale hall. For a parent who grew up on these films, half the fun is watching your kids meet the same characters in the same rooms — it’s a genuinely three-generation exhibition, not a kids-only play space.

item.title: Xiamen Lingling Halloween from ¥59 (≈$8): Animal Kingdom + Award-Winning Circus Show
item.description:
Deal price: Animal Kingdom ticket — ¥59 (≈$8, was ¥140, about 42% of list) · Valid Oct 17 – Nov 29, 2026, weekends only · ⏰ refundable anytime, auto-refund on expiry

In Jimei’s Xinglin district, Xiamen Lingling International Circus City runs an autumn weekend format built for families: the Animal Kingdom opens for afternoon entry — giant pandas, giraffes you can get close to, ring-tailed lemurs, alpacas, white tigers and brown bears — and at 18:30 the big top lights up for “Forest Secret Realm,” a gold-medal circus production staged in a Guinness-record circus theatre seating 10,000. It was created by a team whose credits include Chimelong’s circus choreography and Cirque du Soleil technical consulting, on a rare water-and-land dual stage mixing fountain screens with fire acts; the headline Kenyan “Wheel of Death” has been upgraded to six wheels at 17 metres high. Buy the circus ticket and the same day’s Animal Kingdom entry is included free — one voucher, one afternoon-to-evening outing, no ticket exchange: buy by 15:00 the same day (19:00 for the circus tier) and scan in with your ID and QR code.

item.title: Qiandaohu 3-Night All-Meals Stay from ¥239 (≈$33): JunTing Hotel by Central Lake
item.description:
Deal price: 1 night + 3 buffet meals for two — ¥239 (≈$33, was ¥666) · Up to 3 nights / 3 rooms · Valid Sep 8 – Dec 31, 2026 · ⏰ Refundable if unreserved

The JunTing Hotel （千岛湖中心湖区鱼街君亭酒店， Building 3, 427 Nanjing Road, Qiandaohu Town) sits right on the lake’s “Fish Street,” steps from the central-lake pier and the night-cruise pier, about 20 minutes from Qiandaohu high-speed rail station. It’s a compact 7,000㎡ hotel that leans into being a base rather than a destination: the lobby bar doubles as a book bar with welcome coffee or tea, there’s a gym, and the kids’ playground (ocean-ball pool, slide, climbing frame) is built to burn off a full day. The headline, though, is the math — every tier bundles three buffet meals a day in the hotel’s ground-floor restaurant (breakfast, lunch and dinner), so a 3-night superior-room stay with nine meals for two lands at ¥599, about ¥200 a night all-in.

item.title: “Golden Soup Passport” Hot-Spring Card ¥168 (≈$23): One Soak Each at 28 Hot Springs Across 9 Provinces
item.description:
Deal price: one soak each at 28 hot springs — ¥168 (≈$23, was ¥1,969, about 9% of list) · Valid May 13 – Dec 31, 2026, any day of the week · ⏰ refundable anytime if unreserved

The “Golden Soup Passport” (金汤护照) is a returning bestseller for hot-spring season: one ¥168 real-name card covers one visit each at 28 well-known hot-spring resorts across 9 provinces — Fujian and Guangdong are the densest clusters, which makes it a natural fit for families based in the southeast. Think of it less as a single ticket and more as a winter soaking itinerary: Xiamen’s Riyuegu, Fuzhou’s Minggu pavilion inside the Hot Spring Museum, the cave springs and forest springs scattered through Fujian, then Qingyuan’s Xilegu and Huizhou’s Nankunshan Yunding over the border in Guangdong. At ¥168 for the lot, using even four or five venues already beats paying gate prices.

item.title: Anji Cloud Grassland Resort 2 Nights ¥699 (≈$99): Kids' Activities, Free Dress-Up Photos & Egg Collecting
item.description:
Deal price: 2 nights for ¥699 (≈$98, was ¥988) · Valid Oct 7 – Dec 10, 2026 · Not usable Nov 14–15 · Saturday stays +¥100/night

High in Anji’s bamboo hills (Shanchuan Township), the Cloud Grassland resort spreads across roughly 5,000 mu of mountain: the Xianxia Town at the 1,168 m summit runs 100+ immersive performances day and night with costumed NPCs hidden around its lanes; the High Mountain Grassland has a Hobbit-style village, rainbow and rail grass-sliding, a cloud train and a petting zoo (alpacas, ponies, Dorper sheep); and the Cliff Heartbeat park adds a 2.3 km cable car, the A-shaped Sky Stair glass platform jutting 80.9 m over the cliff, cloud swings up to 12 m and an 82 m crystal corridor bridge. This autumn off-peak bundle puts you in the resort’s Yunshanjing Hotel — an elegant king/twin for 2 consecutive nights — and the voucher is redeemable across all three resort hotels: upgrade to a basic room at the bamboo-hidden Yinzhu (white-walled villa clusters, no more than three floors, rooms with viewing balconies) or the pet-friendly Songsushu Tribe Hotel (100 treehouse-style rooms among the pines, with squirrels, alpacas, marmots and peacocks on site, a mini coaster, game rooms and kids’ toiletries provided) for +¥200/night, paid on site.
